Thus, this is a new topic in 2024 with no 2023 counterpart.

comparisons.peer_topic: Impact of Pillar Two on company's 2024 financials
comparisons.peer_summary: The impact of Pillar Two legislation on the company for the fiscal year 2024 was immaterial, and the company continues to evaluate the impact of proposed and enacted legislative changes on its effective tax rate and cash flows as new guidance becomes available.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose that the OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax has not had a material impact on their 2024 financials, despite the legislation becoming effective in certain jurisdictions. NVIDIA explicitly states in its assessment for the next fiscal year (FY2025) that Pillar Two is not expected to materially impact its effective tax rate or cash flows based on enacted laws. AMD confirms that for the fiscal year 2024, the impact was immaterial and notes it continues to evaluate the impact of proposed and enacted legislative changes. Both companies treat the tax regime change as a compliance matter with negligible immediate financial consequence.

sentences.text: Based on enacted laws, Pillar Two is not expected to materially impact our effective tax rate or cash flows in the next fiscal year.
For 2024, the impact to us associated with Pillar Two was immaterial.
